hooks.name: Self-Challenge Before Writing Docs
hooks.description: Forces a self-audit prompt before writing any file to the docs/ folder, reminding to check for missed verbs, nouns, qualifiers, and gaps.

action.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$inputStr = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $data = $inputStr | ConvertFrom-Json; $path = $data.tool_input.path; if ($path -match '^d:\\BL_UNI\\docs\\' -or $path -match '/docs/') { exit 0 } else { exit 0 }"
